 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Indianapolis Colts running back Seth McGowan has played his way into the Week 11 fantasy football conversation.
 Bleacher Report's Moe Moton named McGowan a sleeper for Thursday night's game against the Houston Texans , noting his increased workload and touchdowns in consecutive games.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Moton recommended the rookie as a flex option.
 McGowan made a case for more carries in Sunday's 24-22 win over the Miami Dolphins .
 He ran 12 times for 77 yards and a touchdown, setting career highs in attempts and rushing yards. Jonathan Taylor added 83 yards on 16 carries, giving Indianapolis 160 rushing yards from the pair.
 The seventh-round pick has 285 yards and two touchdowns on 55 carries this season. His 5.2 yards per attempt lead all rookie running backs entering Week 11, according to the Colts . He also scored against the Dallas Cowboys in Week 9.
 Although McGowan's role is tied to Taylor, who leads the Colts' backfield, the rookie got two straight handoffs when Indianapolis needed a first down to close out the Miami game. He gained 12 yards and ended the Dolphins' chance at a comeback.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Moton noted that McGowan was rostered in just 24% of leagues in FantasyPros' consensus data.
 If he has a workload near 12 carries, fantasy managers should consider him Thursday, though his scoring outlook still depends heavily on touches and touchdowns.
